<!--

The line above the fixed condition might set brightness to an empty
dict if self.device.appliance.status doesn't have a brightness key.
The condition incorrectly checks exclusively for "brightness is None" so it's better to
check for "not brightness" which contains the previous check but also handles
correctly the empty dict case.

issue_context.title: home_connect show an error in the logs on device update
issue_context.body:
### The problem

The light in my home_connect integration controlled hood is suddenly unavailable after an error is shown in the logs (copied below).

I've already prepared a patch for this. I just created the bug report so the issue can be better tracked than just with a PR.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2023.1.5

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Core

### Integration causing the issue

home_connect

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/home_connect/

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
2023-01-19 06:32:03.146 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.light] home_connect: Error on device update!
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/opt/homeassistant/lib/python3.9/site-packages/homeassistant/helpers/entity_platform.py", line 503, in _async_add_entity
    await entity.async_device_update(warning=False)
  File "/opt/homeassistant/lib/python3.9/site-packages/homeassistant/helpers/entity.py", line 729, in async_device_update
    await task
  File "/opt/homeassistant/lib/python3.9/site-packages/homeassistant/components/home_connect/light.py", line 200, in async_update
    self._brightness = ceil((brightness.get(ATTR_VALUE) - 10) * 255 / 90)
TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for -: 'NoneType' and 'int'
```
```


### Additional information

_No response_

Just a note for completion: I would also prefer the [] operator but I'm just trying to keep the patch simple and I'm used to not changing the coding style of other developers when submitting PRs.
@frenck There are many cases of `.get(ATTR_VALUE)` in that file (and even more in other files in that component). Do you want me to change all of them to use `[ATTR_VALUE]` or only that one?
